{{nutritionsummary|3 tablespoons (45 ml)|4|187|151|16.8 g|2.1 g|1 mg|549 mg|8.4 g|0.2 g|6.9 g|0.5 g|0%|0%|0%|0%}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Salad Recipes|Salad Recipes]] 

This variation on the basic [[cookbook:Vinaigrette|vinaigrette]] is much thicker and goes great with contrasting flavors in salad such as dried cranberries and bell peppers.

==Ingredients==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 5 tablespoons [[cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] (light or virgin)
* 2 teaspoons [[cookbook:Wine vinegar|white wine vinegar]] or [[Cookbook:Cider vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* 1 tablespoon [[cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* [[cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
* Freshly-ground [[cookbook:pepper|pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
# [[cookbook:Mix|Mix]] all ingredients except oil until well blended.
# Slowly mix in oil until fully incorporated.
# Add salt and pepper to taste.
